record_title: Data for: Gene duplication shaped the origin and evolution of the vertebrate olfactory combinatorial code
_help: After publishing, set zenodo_record_id to the NUMERIC id from the record URL (https://zenodo.org/records/<id>). Use the version-specific id, not the concept DOI, so the checksums below stay valid.

predictions.description: Per-run and median binding probabilities, ASR and reference tree.

embeddings_molecules.description: MolFormer ligand embeddings, (754, 768), indexed by smiles_id to join the prediction matrices.

embeddings_pooled.description: Mean-pooled (N, 960) ESM-C 300M matrices. This is what the model consumes.

embeddings_m2or.description: Per-residue (L, 960) ESM-C 300M arrays, 1399 M2OR proteins. Large.

embeddings_reference_tree.description: Per-residue (L, 960) ESM-C 300M arrays, 584 reference-tree proteins. Large.

asr_node_runs.description: Per-node IQ-TREE ancestral-state runs, 433 directories as produced. Includes the .state posteriors over all 20 amino acids at every site. Large; only needed to audit or re-derive the reconstruction.

chemical_space.description: Derived data for the odorant vs natural-product analysis on COCONUT 08-2026: the 730,571-molecule analysis table (universe.parquet), the embedding row index, the UMAP of the full 768-dimensional MoLFormer embedding, cached COCONUT parent structures, and the per-molecule source-organism habitat table.

_help_groups: Each key becomes a --flag on download_zenodo_data.py. Add a group here, not in the script.
